note: Era 3 (2026-08-30, Q52 ruled): courier's reward goes 69 -> 110, and partial tier progress (completedThisTier) now survives extraction. The courier change COMPLETES D53 rather than revisiting it: D53 levelled pay-per-effort at a common 0.115 per WORK-tick, courier has zero work ticks, so the pass computed nothing for it and 69 stood as a pre-effort-pricing leftover while the AI scorer charged courier for two full legs of travel. It ranked last on every board and the era-2 battery read it at 0.17x preference - a type that had never been priced, reading as a balance problem. 110 = the ~34-cell second leg above the one-leg baseline, at 28 ticks/cell, at D53's own rate. Nothing was cut, so D42 is untouched. The tier-progress fix changes what a sortie is worth, so era-2 progression baselines are void: the measured 'median 6 deploys to tier 3' was the OPTIMISTIC number, because a world-day never extracts and so never paid the leak. The version is hashed (D65), so two hosts on different eras cannot agree by accident.
